meta.title: Add Bid is offered on an Upcoming event
gaps: The required Upcoming event state cannot be created or reached from the prepared live event; therefore the specific rule that surrogate bids are accepted before the event opens is not directly tested.
The contrast with vendor-side bidding being refused before the window opens cannot be tested because the prepared state does not provide an upcoming event or a vendor-side bid step.

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Participants tab as required for prepared-state cases.
Ensure the Participants list is rendered and eligible vendor rows are available.
Assert that the configured invited vendor's row offers the Add Bid surrogate-bidding control.
Place a buyer-side bid for the eligible vendor.
Assert that the surrogate bid was accepted and recorded as submitted.
